episodes.synopsis: Main is now an apprentice priestess at the cathedral. How will she adapt to a new life in new surroundings, and how will they react to her?
episodes.title: Apprentice Priestess

episodes.synopsis: The stark contrast of the values at the church compared to life downtown continues to bewilder Main, as she butts heads with her retainers and her expected duties at the church.
episodes.title: Blue Robes and Uncommon Sense

episodes.synopsis: With Fran now fully on her team, Main must then get to work on winning Gil and Delia over.
episodes.title: Needs

episodes.synopsis: Main is taken to the orphanage and collapses in shock when she sees the state it and its inhabitants are in. She wants to help the kids, but will she really be able to?
episodes.title: Orphanage Reforms

episodes.synopsis: As newly appointed orphanage director, Main's first task is to lead a major cleanup of the orphanage and its inhabitants. And as summer comes around, she also has some festivities in mind.
episodes.title: Cleanups and Star Festivals

episodes.synopsis: The friction in Lutz's family caused by his choice of profession comes to a head, and he runs away from home to get away from it all.
episodes.title: The Path Ahead of Lutz

episodes.synopsis: When Main hears that Eva is pregnant, she decides to make a picture book for the baby and looks to recruit Wilma to be her artist. However, she finds a few roadblocks on her path...
episodes.title: New Retainers

episodes.synopsis: With the picture-book production in full sway, Main must navigate several hurdles regarding the process and, more pressingly, Wilma's condition.
episodes.title: Wilma and Holy Scriptures for Kids

episodes.synopsis: The Harvest Festival is here, and Main finds the library ransacked. She is outraged at first, but this may be a welcome opportunity for her...
episodes.title: Harvest Festivals and Staying Home

episodes.synopsis: Main has to break the news to her family that she has to stay in the cathedral over winter. Meanwhile, the request from the knight order looms large over the horizon.
episodes.title: Knight Orders and Requests

episodes.synopsis: Main and the head priest set out to join the knights on a mission to take down a rampage trombe. With this being her first exposure to proper noble society, who knows what perils lie in Main's path?
episodes.title: Trombe and Battles

episodes.synopsis: Tasked with healing the land ravaged by the trombe, Main has to put on a show. How that will affect the way the onlookers see her is anybody's guess... and so is how the head priest will react.
episodes.title: Dreamlike World
